text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's finally, finally, finally here!! The 
Mile CS, where I get to compete against 
Oguri-senpai!! The dream I've had since I 
was little is finally within reach—!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! Thank you so, so much... for 
believing in my "dream"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm off to make my "dream" come true!! 
Together with Oguri-senpai, the greatest 
rival ever, we'll make a legendary clash 
that marks the start of someone's 
"dream"!!
